dataset_source.title: Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds
dataset_source.attribution: Source data: Tiago F. T. Cerqueira, Antonio Sanna and Miguel A. L. Marques, Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds, Materials Cloud 2023.163 v1, DOI 10.24435/materialscloud:qv-bq, CC BY 4.0. This catalogue is a derived projection with additional source-state screening commentary.

scope: Previously private source-model screening is now published as unscored source-computed material-design hypotheses. Historical private-screening wording is retained as context. These predictions are new to this reviewed catalogue only; experimental confirmation, worldwide first discovery, formal RPS and human scientific review are not claimed.
source_tc_scope: Source isotropic Eliashberg Tc in K at mu*=0.1 is a model result, not experimental Tc. It is a separate source product and is not associated with an individual Gaussian width or a numerical uncertainty interval.
pairing_response_scope: Retained ten-width lambda contrasts and independent source Tc products support bounded source-model comparisons. Chemical, mass, volume, sampling, spin and SOC effects can co-change; no universal causal or error-bound interpretation is assigned.
risk_tag_scope: Attention labels support browsing. Element labels are not measured magnetic ground states, rejection criteria or calibrated potential scores; no label does not mean no risk.

candidate.prototype: Pm-3 ordered A15-derived eight-site network with six Nb chain sites and distinct Pd and Pt single-site roles
candidate.prototype_evidence: Pm-3 ordered A15-derived eight-site network with six Nb chain sites and distinct Pd and Pt single-site roles
candidate.support_meaning: Preliminary screened support within the stated source model. This ordinal level is not a probability, formal RPS score or human scientific review.
candidate.risk_summary: Target Gamma optical compression is positive and sampled path nonnegative. Antisite disorder, A15-chain softening/CDW and Pt SOC are the leading physical competitors; fine Fmax is 0.018999 eV/A. The PtAu control has much higher lambda but an actual negative source path and is retained, rather than silently treated as a stable superior candidate. Changed ecutwfc/PP/code between Ta and Pd remain explicit numerical-model confounds.
candidate.ambient_scope: Both source SCFs converge, near-zero coarse forces/stress and bounded fine response are measured. Fine Fmax=0.018998654 eV/A, P=0.032 GPa, full max stress=0.032 GPa. Gamma optical compression is positive beyond printing bound and sampled path has no signed negative values. All listed q outputs have JOBDONE/last response convergence and no routine errors. This supports a finite-grid local/metastable source model, not global hull or experimental synthesis.
candidate.route_response: Pd replaces Ta on the unique non-Pt cation site while all six Nb and the Pt site retain mapped roles. Volume contracts 2.8275%, Nb-chain nearest distance falls 0.0253916 A and Nb-Pd versus Nb-Ta falls 0.0273996 A. All ten lambda values rise 31.713–43.016%, with separate Eli mu=.1 12.195 to 15.273 K; measured coupled chemistry/chain construction is not pure strain causality.
candidate.next_action: Hold ordered Pd/Ta and Pt roles fixed while matching cutoff/PP, volume and sampling, and compare an antisite or chain distortion competitor. A persistent stable direct coupling gain supports the screen; loss under common numerical controls or a nontranslation soft branch opposes it.

seven_criteria.identity: Complete ordered CIF/literal coarse-fine input/Gamma periodic species-site association is numerically supported; source input geometry and full tensor/forces are retained. Export occupancy is a discrete computational convention; source experimental P/T/occupancy and actual compiled unit constant are unknown. Exact-version input defaults scope the configured neutral scalar spin1/noSOC model, not magnetic ground state.
seven_criteria.quantitative_route_response: Pd replaces Ta on the unique non-Pt cation site while all six Nb and the Pt site retain mapped roles. Volume contracts 2.8275%, Nb-chain nearest distance falls 0.0253916 A and Nb-Pd versus Nb-Ta falls 0.0273996 A. All ten lambda values rise 31.713–43.016%, with separate Eli mu=.1 12.195 to 15.273 K; measured coupled chemistry/chain construction is not pure strain causality.
seven_criteria.pairing_relevance: Exact target and mapped control direct source lambda arrays have the same favorable sign at all ten common broadening tokens; omega_ln has explicit K units and separate Eli/McM mu=.1 tables remain independent. Same underlying q mesh is observed. The sensitivity range is not a physical error bound; sigma units, full-BZ convergence, experimental Tc and pure-geometry causality remain unknown. Literal method differences are declared confounds.
seven_criteria.ambient_feasibility: Both source SCFs converge, near-zero coarse forces/stress and bounded fine response are measured. Fine Fmax=0.018998654 eV/A, P=0.032 GPa, full max stress=0.032 GPa. Gamma optical compression is positive beyond printing bound and sampled path has no signed negative values. All listed q outputs have JOBDONE/last response convergence and no routine errors. This supports a finite-grid local/metastable source model, not global hull or experimental synthesis.
seven_criteria.competition_and_coherence: Target Gamma optical compression is positive and sampled path nonnegative. Antisite disorder, A15-chain softening/CDW and Pt SOC are the leading physical competitors; fine Fmax is 0.018999 eV/A. The PtAu control has much higher lambda but an actual negative source path and is retained, rather than silently treated as a stable superior candidate. Changed ecutwfc/PP/code between Ta and Pd remain explicit numerical-model confounds.
seven_criteria.novelty: Experimental Nb3Pt and A15 alloys are known. The exact two-species ordered Nb6PdPt Pm-3 source is not established by binary Nb3Pt or random B-site alloy evidence. The 2026-10-07 exact Nb6PdPt query found no matching experimental superconducting ordered phase; novelty is bounded to this matched ordered-site hypothesis.
seven_criteria.decision: Hold ordered Pd/Ta and Pt roles fixed while matching cutoff/PP, volume and sampling, and compare an antisite or chain distortion competitor. A persistent stable direct coupling gain supports the screen; loss under common numerical controls or a nontranslation soft branch opposes it.
